name: @aos/knowledge-intelligence
description: AOS Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence — the standalone, in-memory engine that analyzes knowledge, discovers insights, identifies relationships, detects gaps and duplicates, classifies and tags knowledge, scores health/freshness/coverage/completeness/readiness/quality/risk/priority, recommends improvements, and generates intelligence reports across the Knowledge Runtime. Provides a real 11-stage analysis pipeline, deterministic Jaccard/cosine similarity, a Specification-pattern classification engine, and a shared weighted-scoring/normalization/threshold utility reused by every scoring engine. Pure domain: no database, no network, no filesystem persistence, no external AI model or embedding provider, no OS-dependent timers — everything in-memory and driven by an injectable clock. This package imports ZERO other @aos/* packages at runtime; it defines its own exception base class, its own lightweight event-publishing mechanism, and its own module contract so it remains fully standalone.
